passwordReset.requestIntro: Enter the email address you log in with. If it belongs to an account, you'll get an email with a link to choose a new password.
passwordReset.requestSent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
passwordReset.invalidLink: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.
passwordReset.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
passwordReset.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
passwordReset.success: Your password has been reset. Log in with your new password.

emailVerification.notVerifiedHint: Open the link in the verification email we sent to this address, or send a new one.

compatibility.unknown: This item cannot play on this device with the server’s current playback settings.
compatibility.destination_media_unsupported: This device does not report support for a playable media format.
compatibility.browser_rejected_source: This browser could not play the available media. No other compatible version is available with the server’s current playback settings.
compatibility.source_stream_metadata_unavailable: Playback needs stream information that is missing. Scan this item again to update it.
compatibility.source_color_metadata_unavailable: Playback needs video color information that is missing. Scan this item again to update it.

compatibility.video_bit_depth_unsupported: This device cannot play the video’s color depth without re-encoding.
compatibility.video_hdr_unsupported: This device cannot play this HDR video without re-encoding.
compatibility.subtitle_burn_in_required: These subtitles need to be burned into the video, which requires re-encoding.
compatibility.subtitle_delivery_unsupported: This device cannot play the stream format needed to preserve this video’s subtitles.
compatibility.video_codec_unsupported: This device cannot play the video codec without re-encoding.
compatibility.video_dimensions_unsupported: This device cannot play the video’s resolution without re-encoding.
compatibility.audio_codec_unsupported: This device cannot play the audio codec without re-encoding.
compatibility.audio_channels_unsupported: This device cannot play this audio channel layout without re-encoding.
